palette_note: Colour interpretation using the PofBC source flag palette; original SuperHost printing inks have not been authenticated.
notes: Twelve existing PofBC flag path strings are preserved exactly; only placement and fills change.
The newspaper and CIPO star arrangements are separately reconstructed from geometric five-point stars.
Letterforms are custom structural reconstructions. Exact original typefaces are unverified.
Slogan outlines are cubic fits of a mathematical brush-nib sweep over hand-authored skeletons.
Dense overlapping star centres are partly inferred; source JSON distinguishes them.
Core logo only: surrounding newspaper copy, minister credit, and separate CIPO tourism endorsement are outside this reconstruction.
Revision 2 refines shared serif masters and brush skeletons; no source contours are traced.
Flag and star geometry and transforms are unchanged from revision 1.
Brush outline cubic fitting tolerance is 0.075 CIPO reference unit.
